document_requests_received_state_check.name: document_requests_received_state_check
document_requests_received_state_check.value: ("document_requests"."status" = 'received' and "document_requests"."received_at" is not null) or ("document_requests"."status" <> 'received' and "document_requests"."received_at" is null)

work_items_separation_check.name: work_items_separation_check
work_items_separation_check.value: "work_items"."assignee_id" is null or "work_items"."reviewer_id" is null or "work_items"."assignee_id" <> "work_items"."reviewer_id"
